findings.detail: Equity rows with source maturity date N/A were normalized with acquisition dates in maturity_date, causing X10 to fire.

rationale: X10 flags maturity_date before the 2025-06-30 report date. The source schedule header places Acquisition Date at column 12 and Maturity Date at column 14; the cited equity rows have N/A in the maturity-date position and the 2024 dates in the acquisition-date position. The stored maturity_date values therefore came from the wrong source column, so the flagged dataset rows are real extraction errors rather than legitimately matured positions.
